description: This file implements an Android service (`DeviceNotificationListenerService`) that listens for notification events, processes notifications (posting/removing), maintains a local store, and emits events about notification changes. It provides functions for external components to query and interact with notifications, including actions like open, dismiss, and reply.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a notification with key details like package name, title, text, timing, and flags for ongoing/clearable status.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationSnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of current notifications, including whether notifications are enabled, the connection status, and the list of notification entries.

classes.name: NotificationActionRequest
classes.description: Structure representing a request to perform an action on a notification, such as open, dismiss, or reply, with optional reply text.

classes.name: NotificationActionResult
classes.description: Result of executing a notification action, indicating success or failure with optional message and code.

classes.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService
classes.description: Main Android service that listens for notification events and manages notification data and actions.

methods.name: sanitizeNotificationText
methods.description: Cleans and trims notification text characters to a maximum length.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationEntry.toJsonObject
methods.description: Converts a notification entry into a JSON object.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onListenerConnected
methods.description: Handles establishing the connection, marking the service as active and updating stored notifications.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onNotificationPosted
methods.description: Processes a newly posted notification and updates the store and emits change events.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.onNotificationRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of notifications, updates store, and emits change event.

methods.name: DeviceNotificationListenerService.executeActionInternal
methods.description: Performs actions like open, dismiss, or reply on a specific notification.
